description: The home for every skill that stands on its own and has no topical plugin of its own, in one install instead of a shelf of one-skill plugins: harness and environment config, session discipline, research, diagrams and data visualization, repo and project setup, sandboxed opencode instances, and Obsidian plugin development. Membership is derived, not curated — a gate re-reads the skill bodies every run and keeps out anything that needs a companion agent or hook, anything a topical plugin already owns, plus a documented exemption class for skills that prescribe an opt-in system the consumer chooses deliberately, in-repo or external. Release history: https://github.com/hsb3/dotfiles-agents/releases.
name: solo-skills
